name: ADSLabs MC Server
description:
ADSLabs SMP: Bedrock Survival

A survival multiplayer server for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Play from Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, iOS or Android in a shared survival world.

Version: latest Bedrock (it updates automatically)

Slots: 150

Hosting: a dedicated server, so it should run without lag

Gameplay: survival, close to the normal game [difficulty: Normal/Hard]

Rules: No griefing, no stealing, no cheats or hacked clients, and be respectful in chat. [add any others]

How to join: go to Servers, then Add Server.

Address: bedrock.adslabs.dev

Port: 19132

Console players (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch) can’t add custom servers without a workaround such as BedrockTogether or a DNS trick.
